events.title: Make-Up & Effects
events.description: Presenter: Skye Meredyth. Watch how a professional make-up artists applies special make-up effects to a volunteer live on stage

events.title: CHARACTER UNLOCKED
events.description: Presenter: Sandra Temple. A journey into fantasy, illusion, and transformation. "What if your costume didn't stop at the edge of your clothing? What if your skin became part of the costume itself?"

events.title: Cosplay X Championship - Existing Character
events.description: Presenter: GhMX. This is the main Cosplay X Showcase & Championship competition!

events.title: Harrison Hill - The World of punkcreations
events.description: Presenter: punkcreatios. From ballgowns to battle armour this panel will introduce you to many different ways of which you can build a Cosplay give you some insight from professionals leading the charge with those materials and hopefully some other cool tips and tricks along the way! Join us to look at everything from foam, leather, fabric, 3-D print printing and every cool thing in between.

events.title: My cosplay sucks, and how do I fix it!
events.description: Presenter: Zerebin. Cosplay is amazing but mistakes happen, errors compound and things go wrong. So, time to sit down and talk about the failures made by some experienced cosplayers while making their costumes to help make sure you don't make ther same mistakes.

events.title: THE LUCKWEAVER'S TAVERN - Live Podcast!
events.description: Presenter: The Mimic’s Den. Welcome to The Luckweaver's Tavern! A cosy, whimsical and slightly eldritch adventure, bringing the magic of The Mimic's Den podcast to the stage for the very first time.

events.title: Cosplay X Championship - Original Character
events.description: Presenter: GhMX. Cosplay X Showcase & Championship competition for Original character designs!

events.title: Vtubing
events.description: Presenter: kurara_fox. Get an insight on how to be a Vtuber and balance your work & social life around it.
